notes.text: An account without Google or Apple is now deleted after 30 days without use. The welcome screen and Profile say so, and connecting Google or Apple keeps your data.
You can now rate the app from Profile › Support and feedback, with "Rate the app".
A bill opened from Home or All expenses now goes back straight to where you opened it, without passing through its group.
Fixed the "+N" bubble of a stack of faces showing under the first face instead of over it.
